prompt: A haunting, symbolic visualization of air pollution's impact on human life. A pair of human lungs formed entirely from a dense modern city skyline, with buildings, factories, and roads shaping the lung structure. Thick black smog fills the lungs from within, with smoke rising from industrial areas and slowly suffocating the structure. Parts of the lungs appear eroded, crumbling, and fragile, as if decaying from inside. No text, no labels, no numbers. Cinematic lighting, dark muted tones, high contrast, hyper-detailed, editorial magazine cover style. Mood: somber, suffocating, oppressive, emotionally heavy. Single frame, centered composition, strong figure-ground contrast, minimal background.
insight: Air pollution turns the act of breathing into a life-threatening risk for millions.
